summary: Configured `/srv/reports` on node1 with persistent writer/read-only group ACLs and verified operation before and after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Applied access and default ACLs granting writers `rwx`, readers `r-x`, and others no access.
Verified separate writer identities can create and modify shared content.
Verified readers can read but cannot append, create, or delete.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot ID changed from `151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a` to `48e8bce5-1b79-4770-8ff3-21e570597c32`.
Verified system health, data integrity, ACL persistence, inheritance, and role behavior after restart.

evidence.requirement: Members of report-writers can modify `/srv/reports` contents
evidence.summary: Shows group creation, writer ACLs, setgid inheritance, and successful modifications by distinct writer identities before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Members of report-readers have read-only access
evidence.summary: Shows reader `r-x` ACLs, successful reads, denied append/create/delete attempts, and unchanged data hashes.

evidence.requirement: Permissions propagate to new files and subdirectories
evidence.summary: New objects inherited the `report-writers` group, writable writer ACLs, read-only reader ACLs, and default directory ACLs.

Captures the healthy pre-restart baseline, acknowledged safe reboot, changed boot identity, running system and active SSH, read-write filesystem, exact persisted data hash, restored ACLs, and successful post-restart role tests.
